alt: A close-up view of a vintage-style suitcase featuring black and wood-grain panels, gold-colored metal trim with rivets, a leather handle, and travel stickers including one for Paris, France.
An elaborate cake designed to look like an open treasure chest overflowing with edible items, including a map labeled "Africa," a blue baseball, and a small pumpkin, all surrounded by autumn leaves.

A close-up of a cake decorated to resemble a vintage black and gold travel trunk, featuring fondant straps, corner protectors, a "France" luggage tag, and a base adorned with realistic-looking pebbles and seashells.
A sculpted cake depicts a woman in pink pants and a brown jacket sleeping on a bed of autumn leaves atop a large black suitcase, with an open trunk and a bare tree in the background.
A sculpted cake of a woman with black hair and closed eyes lies peacefully on a pink pillow, wrapped in a brown shroud and surrounded by autumn leaves.
